name: mirage
text:
Released v1.0.79: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.79

All-time profit is now winnings paid on bets and bids with a final result minus what they cost. Wallet, deposits and withdrawals aren't used anywhere in it. Open and unfinished bets are left out of the totals and graphs, and the card says how many are waiting. Each day is its sports slate (Eastern, 5 am to 5 am), so a late game stays on the night it started, and the all-time number is the sum of those days. It covers every day back to your first bet.

Checked: the new all-time number equals the sum of the daily settled profits, and all 4,189 tests pass. I haven't compared the card against your live data yet. Open the Tracker and tell me if it differs from your own count of settled bets.

Not finished: finding the ~$72 gap against the old wallet figure (CH87c) is still open.
